correctness.rationale: With prescribed SSPRK(3,3) stages A and c, order-1/2 conditions give precisely ((1-v)/2,(1-v)/2,v). R_v(z)=1+z+z²/2+v z³/4 follows by powers of A. For any 2-state generator Q, write Q=-(a+b)(I-Pi); choosing v=0 at s<2 and 4(1-s+s²/2)/s³ at s>=2 keeps R_v(-s) in [0,1] and 0<=v<=1, hence nonnegative stochastic endpoint for every step. For equal-rate three-state pure-birth Q, nonnegative first-column middle and last entries force v>=4(z-1)/(3z²) and v<=1/z, inconsistent for z>4 even over reals. Piecewise v constructions for 0<=z<=4 keep all entries nonnegative, and both inequalities at z=4 force v=1/4 and exactly identity endpoint. Independently recomputed symbolic generator products and rational 2- and 3-state examples, including z=4 and z>4. Formal order only for each fixed v; intermediate stage positivity is not claimed.
